idea: Asymmetric corner-merge family: in a k×k grid, merge an a×a block in one corner and a b×b block in the opposite corner (with a ≠ b allowed). Also split c cells into 2×2, giving count k² − a² − b² + 2 + 3c and sum k + (a + b − a² − b² + c)/k... wait, corrected: (k² − a² − b² + a + b + c)/k. Enumerate all (k, a, b, c) in closed form to cover even and odd residues near n that single-block replacements miss.
